newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close at highs, correction seen.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close at highs, correction seen.

text.p: Madrid stocks extended their upward surge to close at record highs on Thursday, buoyed by a turnaround in the dollar and Wall Street, but traders said they expected to see a small correction before further moves higher.
The general index closed 7.49 points, 1.80 percent, higher at 423.42. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares advanced 93.29, 1.94 percent, to 4,908.85.

"I feel confident about the strength in the market and there is clearly the money to support it, but I am not expecting any further big moves higher before we see some consolidation," said one trader.
Trading centred on four key stocks Endesa, Telefonica, Iberdrola and Repsol, which accounted for 43 percent of total turnover.
Endesa managed to reverse early losses to close 240 pesetas higher at 9,050 after the electricity firm denied it had violated stock market commission rules.
Spanish stock market commission CNMV said on Wedneday it had filed a suit against Endesa for failure to inform it about plans to bid for two regional electricity firms.
Telefonica advanced 35 pesetas to 3,005, Iberdrola ended 40 pesetas higher at 1,705 and Repsol gained 95 pesetas to 4,855.
